eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 54 · Data Types, Strings, Dates and Modern T-SQL

code:
SELECT BusinessEntityID, FirstName,
       COALESCE(MiddleName, '') AS MiddleNameOrBlank,
       LastName
FROM Person.Person;
caption: A real MiddleName passes through; a NULL becomes ''.

code:
SELECT p.BusinessEntityID,
  COALESCE(pp.PhoneNumber, ea.EmailAddress,
           'No contact on file') AS BestContact
FROM Person.Person AS p
LEFT JOIN Person.PersonPhone AS pp
  ON pp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN Person.EmailAddress AS ea
  ON ea.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID;
caption: Checked left to right — only falls through when the one before it is NULL.
NULL + anything is NULL — COALESCE stops it before it starts.

subtitle: They look similar — the differences are a classic interview topic.
